title: reading an undeclared computed field is an error
purpose: Only declared computed fields are readable.

failure.justification: An undeclared cap field may be rejected statically or at the read.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 11.2.1: `cap::field` reads a declared computed field; `missing` is not declared.
